title: Advanced Building Floor Plan 3D Navigator with Scoring
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements an advanced 3D building floor plan navigator with a scoring system. Requirements:

## Scene Setup
- Create a 5-story building where each floor is a flat rectangular slab (20x20 units, 0.3 units thick) stacked vertically with 4 units between each floor center (floor 0 at y=0, floor 1 at y=4, floor 2 at y=8, floor 3 at y=12, floor 4 at y=16).
- Each floor slab should be a different color: Floor 0=#8B4513 (brown), Floor 1=#4682B4 (steel blue), Floor 2=#2E8B57 (sea green), Floor 3=#DAA520 (goldenrod), Floor 4=#8B008B (dark magenta).
- On each floor, place exactly 3 room boxes (opaque walls, open top) of varying sizes. Room boxes are 3 units tall with walls 0.1 units thick. Rooms on each floor should be at different positions but not overlapping. Give each room a unique name like 'Room_F0_A', 'Room_F0_B', etc.
- Place a small glowing sphere (radius 0.3, emissive yellow) as a 'collectible' inside each room (15 collectibles total, 3 per floor). Each collectible hovers 1 unit above its floor.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light from (10, 30, 10) with intensity 0.8. Add soft shadows.
- Use a perspective camera starting at position (30, 20, 30) looking at the building center (0, 8, 0).
- Add OrbitControls for camera manipulation.

## Floor Visibility System
- Only one floor is 'active' at a time. The active floor and all floors below it are visible. Floors above the active floor are hidden (visible=false).
- Start with floor 0 as the active floor (only floor 0 visible).
- Provide two DOM buttons: 'Floor Up' (id='btn-floor-up') and 'Floor Down' (id='btn-floor-down') to navigate between floors.
- Also support keyboard: ArrowUp to go up a floor, ArrowDown to go down a floor.
- Clamp active floor between 0 and 4.
- When changing floors, animate the camera Y position smoothly over 0.5 seconds to center on the new active floor (target Y = activeFloor * 4).

## Player Marker
- Place a small cone (radius 0.4, height 0.8, color red) as the player marker on the active floor. It sits on top of the active floor slab.
- The player marker can be moved with WASD keys: W=forward(-Z), S=backward(+Z), A=left(-X), D=right(+X). Movement speed is 0.2 units per keypress.
- Clamp the player marker position to stay within the floor bounds: X in [-9.5, 9.5], Z in [-9.5, 9.5].
- The player marker Y position always matches the top of the active floor slab (activeFloor * 4 + 0.15 + 0.4).

## Collectible & Scoring System
- When the player marker is within 1.5 units (XZ distance) of a collectible on the SAME floor, the collectible is 'collected': it becomes invisible and the score increments.
- Each collectible can only be collected once.
- Display the score in a HUD div (id='hud-score') showing 'Score: X / 15'.
- Display the current active floor in a HUD div (id='hud-floor') showing 'Floor: X'.
- Display a timer in a HUD div (id='hud-timer') showing elapsed seconds since page load as 'Time: Xs'.

## Scoring Bonus
- Track a 'bonus' value that starts at 1000 and decreases by 1 every second. Minimum bonus is 0.
- Display bonus in HUD div (id='hud-bonus') showing 'Bonus: X'.
- When all 15 collectibles are gathered, freeze the bonus and display 'COMPLETE! Final Score: {score * 100 + bonus}' in a div (id='completion-msg') that is initially hidden.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- activeFloor: number (0-4)
- playerPos: {x, y, z} — current player marker world position
- score: number (0-15)
- bonus: number (integer, 0-1000)
- totalCollectibles: 15
- collectedIds: array of collected collectible names (strings)
- floorsVisible: array of 5 booleans indicating each floor's visibility
- isComplete: boolean
- elapsedTime: number (seconds since load, integer)
- cameraY: number (current camera Y position)
- roomCount: number (total rooms across all floors, should be 15)

## HUD Styling
- Position all HUD elements in the top-left corner, stacked vertically, with white text, black semi-transparent background, padding 8px, font-family monospace, font-size 14px, z-index 1000.
- Place Floor Up/Down buttons in the top-right corner with clear labels.
- The completion message should be centered on screen, large font, green text, hidden by default.
physics_constraints: Player marker must remain clamped within floor bounds [-9.5, 9.5] on X and Z axes. Collectible pickup radius is 1.5 units in XZ plane on same floor only. Bonus decreases linearly at 1/second from 1000, clamped to 0. Floor visibility is cumulative downward from active floor. Camera Y animates to match active floor center.
